liveForcedGauge.originalDerivativeOfPhaseInLIsZero: The exact phase p*theta + pz*Z/epsilon + x0*R - v*(p*F+pz*G) has no L-dependence since Lv=0. The radial physical carrier is therefore governed by n, and an amplitude fast radial coefficient does not multiply an extra carrier loss.
liveForcedGauge.nativeBoundaryScope: Both modes have the admitted original positive normal denominator and zero initial data. The transverse factor and all required derivatives are flat on the outer transverse interval when |xi|>=3r0/4. The explicit psi vanishes at both ends of the pulse interval with open neighborhoods. The same original shell, band, mesh, reference and flat-join premises are retained; the global classical seam verdict remains OPEN.

liveCartesianGaugeSlotDemand.exactHessianTerm: a_reference^2*(cos theta)^x*(sin theta)^y times Cartesian component rotation and (partial_Y0^2+2 vr1 partial_Y0 partial_Y1+vr1^2 partial_Y1^2) for x+y=2, z=0.

pureL2MeanClosure.structurallyRequiredSourceTerm: a_own U_r * L^3(Delta_j) from L^2 applied to the exact ordinary mean gradient term a_own U_r L(Delta_j) in C94.
pureL2MeanClosure.admissionScope: Use only the original fixed-label, same chart, smooth short mean/pressure radial closure and the original outer F/G, b, covariance and positive frame premises. L commutes with original translations and fixed d; it does not move either radial endpoint or evaluate extra cells. FiveMap is zero only in the admitted C91 outer comparison support.

pureL2NativeForcedExtension.noLDerivativeOfFrameNormalCutoffOrGauss: The fixed original lift has Lv=0. The original H_w preserves L, xi and d. Matrices, B, B_left, normal and reciprocal normal length are independent of Y before substituting w and depend on Y only through v afterward. No spatial differentiation of a pulse endpoint remains in (R,Z,L).
pureL2NativeForcedExtension.newModeOneDemandOnlyPureMeanL3: Under mode-one exact conservative/linear cancellation, the highest ordinary mean gradient is first order. Differentiate its L part twice, with other source derivatives already in C91. The new mean-row constants do not exceed the original global field caps. Distributing two L derivatives and the original physical scalar operations uses no more than the four-direction regrouped finite reserve.
pureL2NativeForcedExtension.modeTwoClosure: Use the C94 tangency reduction and two Primary factors with at most one raw derivative between them. No mean, path extension, or new field divisor is introduced.
pureL2NativeForcedExtension.retainedSourceComparisonScope: Conditional same-label outer collar, directed slab, original positive normal-frame and C89 propagator, C91 ordinary field bounds and admitted complete short radial integration. The actual final spatial potential geometric prefactors and all other K1 fields are separate.
